paper.title: ExpeL: LLM Agents Are Experiential Learners
paper.central_claim: ExpeL无需参数更新，自主积累跨任务经验、抽取洞察和检索成功轨迹，在单次未见任务上改善表现并迁移洞察到新领域。

provenance.notes: 按已配置sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol派发；无独立路由回执/会话ID，不探测。

sections_read: 附录A–J：相关工作、环境/模型参数、提示图注、例子及额外结果

evidence.quote: A newly added insight will have an initial importance count of two associated with it, and the count will increment if subsequent operators
evidence.support_explanation: 明确的增删编辑与计数留存规则，不等同外部逐条执行验证。

evidence.quote: After the agent gathers experiences, extracts insights from them, and sets up a vectorstore of successful trajectories, it can proceed to the evaluation.
evidence.support_explanation: 训练任务构造的非权重 insights 与轨迹库在后续评估使用。

evidence.quote: All experiments use four-fold validation, and we report the mean and standard error over the folds.
evidence.support_explanation: 报告折间标准误，不是跨搜索种子的方差/显著性。

evidence.quote:
All agents, including ExpeL, used
gpt-3.5-turbo-0613
when performing actions during evaluation.
evidence.support_explanation: 统一行动模型；不能据此认定构建/上下文预算相等。

evidence.quote: ExpeL matches Reflexion’s performance (40% at R3 vs. 39%) for HotpotQA and even outperforms it for ALFWorld (54% at R3 vs. 59%)
evidence.support_explanation: 作者报告任务性能；Reflexion重试并非同预算改进器对照。

evidence.quote: a better LLM is more advantageous at improving ExpeL’s performance
evidence.support_explanation: 改进器替换有效但并非改进器自我改写。

evidence.quote: Lastly, random sampling has a significant drop in performance, suggesting that our design choice of selecting the most pertinent in-context example is advantageous.
evidence.support_explanation: 检索替代对照支持任务相似度，但未控制全流程成本。

evidence.quote: We train on one half of the dataset and evaluate on the other half, and vice versa.
evidence.support_explanation: 构造/评价任务分开；共享分布/少数公开任务限制泛化。

evidence.quote: Similarly, for WebShop tasks, we evaluated using the same 100 tasks used by ReAct and Reflexion.
However, extra retrieval steps for insights might be needed for truly lifelong learning agents to ensure a manageable context window size.
evidence.support_explanation: 长程增长边界承认，尚未证实持续学习。

evidence.quote: learned insights by the agent are more advantageous than hand-crafted ones; (2) using reflections in addition to success/failure pairs and lists of successes is disadvantageous
evidence.support_explanation: 表3提供人工insights、反思输入及改进器模型替代对照；数值按表3读取。
行动/观察/token成本仅均值；HotpotQA token 4310.06 vs ReAct1319.75，未摊销GPT4构建成本。

evidence.quote: When restricting the ExpeL agent to only one mode of learning (insights-only or retrieval-only),
evidence.support_explanation: 去除两类存储部件的消融。

evidence.quote: We use the same fewshot examples to finetune the insights as the ones that will be used during task execution.
evidence.support_explanation: FEVER转换用目标fewshot而非零目标信息迁移。

claims.text: 单次未见任务受益于两类跨任务经验
claims.selection_vs_test: 半集构造/另一半评估，交换四折
claims.result_denominator: HotpotQA 39±1.7 vs ReAct28±1.4；ALFWorld59±0.3 vs40±0.3；WebShop reward .701 vs .665；100/134/100任务池，均为作者报告
claims.counterevidence: 总计算/上下文不等，未隔离编辑策略
claims.allowed_conclusion: 支持留存经验在所测共享任务族的有限收益

claims.selection_vs_test: 源洞察用目标fewshot转换；固定fewshot用于评估
claims.result_denominator: FEVER70±0.7 vs ReAct63±0.4，四折作者报告
claims.counterevidence: 目标域与源域共用Wikipedia工具，非广泛新域；不是完全零目标信息
claims.allowed_conclusion: 共享工具知识条件下的少样本迁移

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: 作者报告构造集产生的insights/成功轨迹在独立任务半集上改善单次成功率；支持有限任务族留存复用，不支持通用终身改进或改进器自进化。
unresolved: 长期内存增长、全预算因果控制、邻居独立核查

M.reason: 成功/失败对比、局部编辑计数和任务相似检索链可重建，提出原始与抽象互补预测；洞察可靠性与重要性计数假设未验证。

X.reason: 构造/写回/删除和下一任务读取明确；无独立洞察执行门控、版本回滚或长流增长证据。

E.measurement.reason: 成功率、QA exact match、环境完成及WebShop奖励定义可核，公开任务含负结果；WebShop文本代理并不等同真实购买。

E.causality.reason: 同行动模型、store部件移除、替代洞察和检索对照有用；构建GPT4和更多上下文/采样量未同预算，编辑计数未单独隔离。

E.holdout.reason: 半集构造/半集评估且FEVER迁移，不以评估真值重试构造主结果；仍在共享任务族，FEVER用目标fewshot且无独立污染审计。

E.statistics.reason: 四折标准误、100/134任务分母和失败类型存在；无跨构建种子/流顺序方差及显著性检验，按A2止于2。

E.cost.reason: Table6给推理token/行动均值与资源配置；缺洞察GPT4、训练失败轨迹、索引维护的全成本与等预算曲线。

rationale: 跨任务洞察编辑与成功轨迹检索形成可重建留存链，半集评测和部件消融支持有限收益；编辑门控、长程增长和全预算控制仍弱。
